edits.new: Class: a demolition count. The completion report of 26 December 2011 says "The total population affected by the project was 7,025 people (including 2,397 people affected by the land use and 4,628 people affected by house demolition)." The 4,628 is the house-demolition part of that total, not the whole of it. The completion report attaches no relocation verb to this figure. The map's ruling is that a demolished home is a home lost, so the figure stays in the displaced field. Two qualifications. The 4,628 is the total of the column headed "Affected People (Residential Housing)" in the annex's comparison table, and that table's demolition column is headed "Housing/Shops Demolition", housing and shops together; the annex's other table, which does not carry the 4,628, is the one that separates housing demolished from shops and enterprises demolished. And in the comparison table the Zhenhai subproject contributes 60 people to the 4,628, while the other table records no housing demolished at Zhenhai at all, only 5,282 square metres of shops and enterprises. The report also says "All project affected persons (PAPs) were resettled according to the RAPs", a statement about all 7,025 and not a verb attached to the 4,628.
